run_source: Mix of direct official-page fetches and search-engine snippets where noted, for the 36 companies added in the third listing-screenshot batch. Several entities flagged REVIEW as historical/merged/subsidiary/misclassified/not-actually-Vancouver.

rows.source_file: https://newafton.newgold.com/engage-with-us/get-in-touch/
rows.notes: REVIEW: this is the operating entity for the New Afton mine, located near Kamloops (~350km from Vancouver), not a Vancouver office. Owner New Gold Inc was itself acquired by Coeur Mining Inc, completed March 20, 2026. Not an independent Vancouver corporate prospect.

rows.source_file: bioharvest.com (checked; not a mining company)
rows.notes: REVIEW: BioHarvest Sciences is a biotechnology company (plant-based molecule synthesis for nutraceuticals/pharmaceuticals), not a mining company. Likely a NAICS misclassification, similar to TAAT Global Alternatives and Ridgetop Forwarding flagged earlier. Not a mining prospect.

rows.source_file: https://integraresources.com/contact/contact/
rows.notes: General public email used; a named VP Corporate Development & IR (Jason Banducci) appeared in search results but was not present on the official contact page itself, so not recorded.

rows.notes: REVIEW: search results returned conflicting descriptions — a CSE-listed 'global wellness enterprise' making botanically-based consumable products, and a separately-branded 'California cannabis manufacturer' at the same domain. Either way this is a consumer products company, not mining. Likely a NAICS misclassification; not a mining prospect.

rows.source_file: secondary sources (merger press releases; general contact info corroborated across multiple search results)
rows.notes: REVIEW: EMX Royalty Corporation merged with Elemental Altus Royalties Corp on November 13, 2025, with the combined entity renamed Elemental Royalty Corporation (a separate row in this workbook, at a different Vancouver address). EMX no longer exists as an independent entity — recommend treating this row as historical, cross-referenced to Elemental Royalty Corporation.

rows.notes: REVIEW: Pacific Rim Mining was acquired by OceanaGold Corporation in 2013 (OceanaGold is already a row in this workbook). Not independently operating for over a decade.

The address returned by search results appeared to be a garbled composite of two different addresses ('1500-999 West Hastings Street Suite 3123, 595 Burrard Street') — not recorded rather than guessing which is correct. run_notes: 16 of 36 companies flagged REVIEW: misclassified non-mining entries (BioHarvest Sciences, Leef Brands, Sixth Wave Innovations), historically acquired/merged/subsidiary entities (Pacific Rim Mining, Core Gold, EMX Royalty->Elemental Royalty, Polaris Materials, Renaissance Oil, Hillsborough Resources, Golden Lake Exploration, Quintette Coal, Peace River Coal not in this file but flagged separately), project-name vs. entity-name confusion (Red Lake Madsen Mine -> West Red Lake Gold), mine-site operating vehicles (Afton Operating Corporation), an unlocatable entity (NEOS Canada Services), and one confirmed NOT-actually-Vancouver company (Gunnison Copper, real HQ Phoenix AZ). One company (Cambria Gold Mines) is blocked by an active bot-challenge, not bypassed. A registered-agent-suite cluster was identified at 1188 West Georgia St, Suite 1830 (Uranium Royalty Corp, Gold Royalty Corp, Uranium Energy Corp).
